title: MICHIGAN EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT PLAN - Michigan, United States of America
organization: Emergency Management and Homeland Security Division and Michigan Department of State Police
landscapes: Athletics, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Mass Gatherings, Occupational, Urban
description: One of the most important functions of Michigan government is the protection of life, property, and the environment. To meet threats and hazards to these basic needs the state of Michigan (SOM) requires a coordinated response to emergencies and disasters. The Michigan Emergency Management Plan (MEMP) is a comprehensive, all-hazards plan which identifies the processes, policies, priorities, and responsibilities of state agencies, stakeholders, and partners in directing coordinated action in all phases of the emergency management cycle.
